name: 长夜
source: 1413 长夜月 天赋: 「进入战斗时召唤忆灵「长夜」。忆灵「长夜」初始拥有#1[i]点速度，生命上限为长夜月的#2[i]%。」 param = [160, 0.5]
note: The mirror image of 阿格莱雅's 衣匠: here SPEED is a FLAT number (160, nothing to do with the summoner's speed) while HEALTH is a share of hers. One entry shape covers both spellings -- `flat` only, `percent` only, or both -- which is why the spec is a list of derivations rather than two named fields. ⚠ Note the text gives no ATTACK/DEFENCE for 「长夜」 either; see 1402's note for what that means and where it is registered.
